title: 問答題-第1題
question_text: I paro no loma’ namo i, cima ko maolahay a comikay?
chinese_translation: 在你們家中，誰喜歡跑步?
suggested_answer: Ci mama ako ko maolahay a comikay.

title: 問答題-第2題
question_text: Pina to a miheca ko pinanam iso to no Pangcah?
suggested_answer: Lima to a mihacaan ko pinanam ako to no Pangcah.

title: 問答題-第3題
question_text: Samaanen iso a minanam to serangawan no niyaro’?
chinese_translation: 你如何學習部落的文化?
suggested_answer: To mihecahecaan minokay i niyaro’ mikihatiya to ilisin.

title: 問答題-第4題
question_text: O maan a hecian no losay ko kaolahan iso a komaen? I hacowa kiso a komaen to heci no losay?
chinese_translation: 你最喜歡吃什麼水果?你什麼時候吃水果?
suggested_answer: O kiyafes ko kaolahan ako a hecian no losay, i herek no lahok ko kakomaen ako to heci no losay.

title: 問答題-第5題
question_text: Maolah kiso komaen to siraw haw? Naw?
chinese_translation: 你喜歡吃醃肉嗎?為什麼?
suggested_answer: Hai, maolah kako komaen to siraw, nawhani fangsis ko siraw.

title: 問答題-第6題
question_text: O maan ko kaolahan iso a cengel?
chinese_translation: 你最喜歡的顏色是什麼?
suggested_answer: O kahengangay ko kaolahan ako a cengel.

title: 問答題-第7題
question_text: Pararid kiso a mipadang to tayal no loma’ to romi’ami’ad?
suggested_answer: Hai, paraded kako a mipadang to tayal no loma’ to romi’ami’ad.

title: 問答題-第8題
question_text: Maolah kiso a komaen to dongec? naw?
chinese_translation: 你喜歡吃藤心嗎?為什麼?
suggested_answer: Hai, maolah kako a mipadang to tayal no loma’ to romi’ami’ad.
